calls.title: Demo Call with Cristian Vrabie from Fixter
calls.summary: Fiona Nematbakhsh and Cristian Vrabie (from Fixter) discussed pain points with their current A/B testing tool, Chameleon: extra costs for server-side/price testing, desire for simpler visual editing, and need for direct Google Analytics/BigQuery integration. James Shannon (GrowthBook sales rep) demonstrated their product’s strengths—server-side testing included, visual editor, warehouse-native analytics, and built-in feature flags. Next steps: Fixter will share their experiment volume for pricing, and they will schedule a full demo.
